snippet.title: Carmen Sandiego's ThinkQuick Challenge - Yeah, I don't think so.
snippet.description:
Because apparently there are more than a few people who are disadvantaged, deficient, or otherwise impaired in the critical thinking department that solving 300 missions in ThinkQuick Challenge means catching Carmen on the basis of some online encyclopedia in which anyone can write whatever reality they wish in it, I hate to break it to you.

It never happens.

Stop trying to suggest other weird (and frankly, other words and terminology related to the definition of "insane") methods of trying to catch Carmen or otherwise find an ending in this game. It's not going to happen.

Sorry to spoil it for you.
